resources.string: Balanced allows up to 3 compilers; Experimental up to 4, subject to memory limits. More compilers can increase memory use and heat. Applies to startup compilation and requires restarting the game.
Keeps the inherited thread priority during startup compilation. May reduce compilation time at the cost of responsiveness in other apps.
Records compilation times, cache use, process memory and thread priority in the emulator log.
Normal uses the standard PPU cache. Slots 1–9 store independent caches for compilation measurements and use additional storage. Requires restarting the game.
